name: Arctic Restaurant Service & Supply
old_description: Delivery Available  In Business Since 1973  Authorized Warranty Providers for Major Brands
about:
Arctic Restaurant Service & Supply was founded in 1973 in Madisonville, Kentucky, as a family-owned business serving the western Kentucky region. The company has operated continuously for over five decades, building a reputation as a local supplier and service provider for commercial foodservice operations.

The company distributes commercial cooking equipment, refrigeration systems, and restaurant supplies from brands such as Vulcan, Duke, Blodgett, Henny Penny, True Manufacturing, Victory Refrigeration, and Delfield. In addition to sales, Arctic provides refrigeration service and installation, commercial HVAC services, planned maintenance programs, emergency repair available 24/7, parts and accessories with special orders typically arriving in three to four business days, and refrigerated trailer rentals with free delivery within a 60-mile radius. Its technicians are factory-trained, licensed, and insured.

Arctic serves a range of foodservice establishments, from small cafes to large commercial kitchens. Its customer base includes restaurants, hotels, schools, healthcare facilities, and other institutional kitchens across western Kentucky and surrounding areas. The company also supports nontraditional operations such as catering through its trailer rental program.

Arctic differentiates itself as an authorized warranty provider for major brands, offering factory-trained service technicians and 24/7 emergency response. Its family-owned, locally operated structure allows for personalized service, while membership in the ISC Buying Group and CFESA Trade Association provides access to national pricing and industry standards. The company emphasizes fast delivery, in-store pickup, and preventative maintenance plans tailored to each client’s equipment.

name: Arizona Automotive Equipment
old_description: Arizona Automotive Equipment, commonly known in the area as Mohawk Automotive Lifts Southwest, has been serving the Southwest region of the United States since 2004. We are a family-run operation that maintains the highest quality and standards while giving you the personal touch that often gets lost in today’s day and age.
about:
Arizona Automotive Equipment, also known as Mohawk Automotive Lifts Southwest, has been based in Phoenix, Arizona since its founding in 2004. The company was started by Mike and Karen Green with a focus on annual lift safety inspections and detailed reporting to help customers meet OSHA requirements. In January 2021, ownership transferred to Jason and Brandi Byers, a husband-and-wife team who continue the family-run operation.

The business sells heavy-duty automotive lifts and equipment for both commercial shops and personal garages. Its product lineup includes two-post, four-post, mobile column, scissor, and specialty lifts from brands such as Mohawk Lifts, Hunter Engineering, Challenger Lifts, Tuxedo Lifts, and Samson. In addition to sales, the company provides ALI-certified lift inspections and in-house installation services performed by its own technicians, covering everything from single lifts to multi-lift shop projects across the Southwest region.

Customers range from independent automotive repair shops and commercial vehicle service centers to fleet operators and home garage enthusiasts. The company serves the broader automotive lift and equipment industry, with a particular emphasis on safety compliance and proper maintenance for lifts of any manufacturer, brand, or age.

The company highlights its ALI-certified lifts and inspectors, a comprehensive catalog of major brands, a 100% satisfaction guarantee, and personalized service from a local, family-owned team as key differentiators. Its original mission was to provide reliable annual inspections that keep lifts safe and businesses OSHA-compliant.

name: Arizona Fabrication Solutions
old_description: Located in the heart of Queen Creek, Arizona. We are a veteran family owned and operated business, providing all of your metal fabrication needs.
about:
Arizona Fabrication Solutions was founded in 2013 in Queen Creek, Arizona, as a veteran family-owned and operated metal fabrication business. The company was started by Shannon Miazga, an Army veteran with over 12 years of leadership experience and 13 years in production management, together with Bobby Padilla, an Arizona native.

The shop focuses on custom architectural and structural steel fabrication for residential and commercial construction projects across Arizona. Its services include fabricating and installing stair railings, gates, and a range of metal ornamentals such as indoor furniture and outdoor trellises. The company handles projects from design through installation, working with structural steel and other metals to meet custom specifications.

Primary customers are homeowners, contractors, and architects involved in residential and commercial building projects throughout Arizona. The company has delivered custom railings for home renovations, entry gates for commercial properties, and decorative metalwork for both interior and exterior applications.

The founders established the business to provide a single source for custom metal fabrication needs, leveraging military-grade discipline and local knowledge to deliver tailored solutions for Arizona’s construction market.

name: Arizona Mobile Meat Processing
old_description: Hi my name is Jake Giles and I am the Owner/Operator of Arizona Mobile Meat Processing.  I have been cutting meat for over 20 years and have a great deal of pride doing what I do.  I started Arizona Mobile Meat Processing in 2009 here in Northern Arizona.
about:
Arizona Mobile Meat Processing operates from Williams, Arizona, where founder Jake Giles launched the business in 2009 after two decades of cutting meat. Giles, the owner and operator, began with a mobile processing unit designed to travel to ranches and homes throughout northern Arizona, offering on-site slaughter and fabrication for domestic livestock.

The company provides mobile, state-inspected processing for both domestic animals — beef, lamb, goats, and swine — and wild game such as antelope, deer, elk, and javelina. The operation includes a mobile unit equipped for on-farm harvest, cutting, and wrapping, and the company also runs a separate retail butcher shop, Jake's Butcher Shop, in the same area.

Customers include ranchers and hunting families across Coconino, Maricopa, Verde Valley, and Yavapai counties, as well as local 4H clubs that the company sponsors. The service is also used during county livestock auctions, where Arizona Mobile Meat Processing offers special fair pricing for animals sold at the Coconino County Auction, Maricopa County Auction, Verde Valley Auction, and Yavapai Livestock Auction.

Giles started the business to bring inspected processing directly to producers, eliminating the need to transport live animals long distances. The mobile model, combined with state inspection for resale, allows ranchers and hunters to obtain retail-ready cuts while maintaining animal welfare and meat quality.

name: Arizona Plastics Machinery
old_description: is the largest U.S.-based manufacturer of industry-leading drying, conveying, and complete materials-handling systems for the plastics industry.
about:
Arizona Plastics Machinery (APM) operates from Oracle, Arizona, and has served the plastics industry since 1983. The company was founded by Craig, who holds a degree in Plastics Technology and Business and has been providing equipment to plastics manufacturers for over four decades.

APM functions as a manufacturers’ representative, offering a broad portfolio of plastics processing equipment from multiple established brands. Its product lines include Haitian injection molding machines (44 to 7,456 tons), Novatec drying, conveying, and material-handling systems, Thermal Care process cooling equipment, Rapid Granulator size-reduction machinery, Harvard Factory Automation conveyors, Kosmek clamping systems, Santa Fe Machine plasticizing components, Ensign Equipment bulk material handling, and TEKLEEN self-cleaning water filters. The firm works closely with clients to specify and customize auxiliary and primary equipment for their production lines.

The company’s customers are plastics processors across sectors that require injection molding, extrusion, recycling, and auxiliary support systems. APM engages with manufacturers needing new machinery, line optimization, or troubleshooting assistance, drawing on Craig’s direct technical background to match equipment to application requirements.

APM emphasizes three differentiators: a wide range of equipment from manufacturers, expert guidance from a founder with formal plastics education and extensive field experience, and a commitment to quality and reliability through its supplier partnerships.

name: Ark Electrical LLC
old_description: We are a family owned, faith based, full-service residential and commercial electrical contracting company. Providing new construction, remodels, smart home conversions, upgrades repairs and much more. Our team is committed to providing high-quality standards of integrity and exceptional customer service. As an East Mountains company, this grants us the ability to have personable relations with our clients. With our clients help, we have built and continue to build a reputation of excellence, honesty and trust in our community. We look forward to meeting and working with you all.
about:
Ark Electrical LLC was founded in 2019 in Cedar Crest, New Mexico, by Master Electrician Juan Fernandez. The family-owned, faith-based company began with a mission to bring honest, reliable, and quality electrical services to neighbors in the East Mountains region. Fernandez, who serves as the qualifying party with an EE98 license, drew on eleven years of trade experience to launch the business.

The firm provides full-service residential and commercial electrical contracting, including new construction wiring, remodels and additions, smart-home system installations, service and panel upgrades, backup generator installations, EV charger installations, and general electrical repairs. A three-person field team—Fernandez, senior specialist Shawn Hoskinson, and apprentice Carter Paas—handles design, estimating, permitting, NEC compliance, and quality assurance on each project.

Ark Electrical serves homeowners and businesses across Sandia Park, Cedar Crest, Tijeras, Edgewood, and the greater Albuquerque area. Its residential focus includes older-home safety upgrades, manufactured-home electrical services, and smart-home technology integration, while commercial work covers similar upgrade and repair needs for local businesses.

The company differentiates itself through upfront flat-rate pricing, a licensed-bonded-insured guarantee, and a personable, relationship-driven approach rooted in faith-based values. Fernandez emphasizes doing the job once and doing it right, with clear communication from initial consultation through final walkthrough.

name: Arkansas Catering Cabot Arkansas
old_description: Arkansas Full-Service Catering for Corporate Events, Weddings & Private Gatherings
about:
Arkansas Catering by Chef Wayne Schilleci operates from Cabot, Arkansas, and has served Central Arkansas since 2003. The business was founded by Chef Wayne Schilleci, who brought decades of restaurant ownership and operation experience into a catering model focused on chef-driven menus and full-service execution.

The company provides full-service catering for corporate events, weddings, and private gatherings, handling everything from menu development to delivery, setup, service, and cleanup. Menus span breakfast, hors d'oeuvres, lunch, dinner, and dessert, with items such as slow-roasted Angus beef, shrimp or crawfish étouffée, three-layer lasagna, and house-made cinnamon rolls. The team scales to serve hundreds of guests per event without drop in quality or timing, and has executed hundreds of events over more than two decades.

Clients include corporations hosting executive lunches, leadership meetings, grand openings, employee appreciation events, and conferences; couples planning intimate ceremonies or full receptions; and families marking birthdays, anniversaries, showers, reunions, and holiday parties. The service area covers Central Arkansas, with on-site preparation available for private chef-style events.

Schilleci emphasizes "Food with Heart. Service with Standards," positioning the calm, professional presence of his team and a streamlined process from quote to final cleanup as the differentiators that let hosts stay present for their own events.

name: Arkansas Food Equipment
old_description: Since 1991, our value has always been in our quality work. Our repair services are provided by factory-trained service technicians with much industry experience.
about:
Arkansas Food Equipment, based in Cabot, Arkansas, has provided commercial meat processing equipment sales and on-site repair services since 1991. The company operates as Arkansas Food Equipment Sales & Service (AFESS).

The business focuses on two main lines: on-site repair of food service equipment and sales of consumable supplies. Technicians travel in fully stocked service vehicles to fix bread slicers, meat grinders, meat saws, slicers, tenderizers, wrappers, patty machines, scales, vacuum packers, pressure washers, and more. They also offer preventative maintenance contracts. On the supply side, they stock vacuum bags, seasonings and spices, saw blades, clips, and ties.

Customers include meat processors, commercial kitchens, grocery stores, and other food service operations that rely on equipment such as breaking saws, food cutters, cart retrievers, and check stands. The company’s service area centers on Arkansas, with technicians dispatched from Cabot.

The company emphasizes that its value lies in quality work performed by factory-trained technicians with extensive industry experience. On-site service reduces return trips and minimizes downtime, while preventative maintenance contracts aim to shorten downtime and save money.

about:
Arkansas Metal Products operates from Bald Knob, Arkansas, where it has built over 40 years of experience in custom metal fabrication. The company is veteran-owned and family-operated, though the founding year and original founders are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services including plasma profiling, laser profiling, welding, tube and bar processing, forming, drilling, and crane and hoist operations. Design work is handled in-house using AutoCAD, SigmaNEST, SketchUp, and SolidWorks. The facility also runs a custom coating line under the AMP Custom Coating brand, adding protective finishes to fabricated parts. Headcount, facility size, and annual volume figures are not published.

The company serves both industrial clients needing custom fabrication and retail customers through its AMP Outdoor Outfitters line, which targets hunters and outdoor enthusiasts. Specific industry sectors beyond outdoor recreation are not listed.

Arkansas Metal Products emphasizes a lean-minded, skilled fabricator team and a quality management system focused on the processes that achieve consistent results. The company states that every project begins only after a clear understanding of customer specifications, aiming to surpass expectations for craftsmanship and service.
